$comment: MONEY MODULE (pack: orders) — shaped to bizapps-orders' published design: one renewal Order per membership cycle (BO-D40/D45 — the posted Order IS the bill; no invoices), product-typed lines, and payment timing per the GAP-1-approved 3-part mixture (Atradius/CRF primary sources).

paymentTiming.$note: the 3-part mixture: (1) card-at-checkout for event registrations — same-day; (2) auto-pay dues land ON the due date, with a small failed-card retry tail; (3) manual individual dues spread early-to-grace (lateShare mirrors late_renewal_share 0.25); business tiers pay NET-TERMS with the sourced B2B late curve (~45% late, log-normal ~12d median, thin tail capped)
